description: Performance budgets for the guide avatar, measured by scripts/eval_performance.js against a standalone avatar.html in headless Chrome. These are component-level floors — in the real app the build competes with the host page and runs slower — so treat them as regression detectors, not user-facing targets. Budgets sit ~2.5x observed medians.
